Name: Portrait Mod for Bachelors and Bachelorettes only.zip
Author: duchparc
Description:
This zip file contains portrait replacement for bachelors (Sam, Elliot, Sebastian, Harvey, Alex and Shane) and bachelorettes (Haley, Emily, Penny, Leah, Abigail, and Maru) in Stardew Valley.

Here's how to change character portraits :
1. Download the zip file
2. Backup the original xnb files
3. Extract and replace the files under folder \Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).
